name: wever-evidence
description: Read-only evidence inventory checks, work-order drafts and MCP declaration reviews for agent operators.

interface.longDescription: Wever Evidence connects agent operators and developers to three read-only tools: an evidence inventory check, a work-order preparation assistant, and an MCP manifest reviewer. Check what evidence is on record, assemble a structured work order from your own inputs, or review an MCP declaration for completeness. All three tools work only from information you supply or that is already public. Nothing is modified, executed, or transmitted.
defaultPrompt: Compare my available and expected evidence labels.
Review my supplied MCP tool declarations.

positive.prompt: Using only Wever Evidence, for our agent connector release, compare available evidence [integration-test-report, rollback-plan] with expected evidence [integration-test-report, rollback-plan, security-review].
positive.expected_behavior: Report integration-test-report and rollback-plan as exact matches and security-review as missing. Compare labels only, without reading documents or certifying their contents.

positive.prompt: Using only Wever Evidence, compare available evidence [release-checklist, integration-test-report, rollback-plan] with expected evidence [release-checklist, integration-test-report].
positive.expected_behavior: Report release-checklist and integration-test-report as matched, no missing labels, and rollback-plan as unexpected. Explain that complete label coverage does not certify document contents or release readiness.

positive.description: Prepare a release evidence work-order draft
positive.prompt: Using only Wever Evidence, prepare an evidence-inventory work-order draft for service com.weverlabs/diligenceops-inventory and recipient mbx_000000000000000000000000. Available evidence: [integration-test-report, rollback-plan]. Expected evidence: [integration-test-report, rollback-plan, security-review].
positive.expected_behavior: Return a draft for the supplied service and recipient with the supplied evidence labels. Do not submit or execute work, contact the recipient, create records or grant permissions.

positive.description: Review a complete read-only MCP declaration
positive.prompt: Using only Wever Evidence, review this supplied MCP declaration: {"tools":[{"name":"read_release_status","description":"Read the supplied release status","annotations":{"readOnlyHint":true,"destructiveHint":false,"openWorldHint":false}}]}.
positive.expected_behavior: Report that the supplied declaration includes its description and all three supported annotations, with no missing or consequential annotation flags. Do not claim that the server was contacted, its behavior verified or its identity authenticated.

positive.description: Review missing and consequential MCP annotations
positive.prompt: Using only Wever Evidence, review these supplied MCP tool declarations: {"tools":[{"name":"read_release_status","description":"Read the supplied release status","annotations":{"readOnlyHint":true,"destructiveHint":false,"openWorldHint":false}},{"name":"delete_release_record","description":"Delete a release record","annotations":{"readOnlyHint":false,"destructiveHint":true,"openWorldHint":true}},{"name":"lookup_evidence","description":"Look up an evidence label"}]}.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify missing annotations for lookup_evidence and consequential annotations for delete_release_record. Assess only the supplied declarations without contacting servers, executing tools, verifying identities or granting permissions.

negative.description: Evidence modification and deletion are unsupported
negative.prompt: Using only Wever Evidence, delete rollback-plan from my stored evidence and replace integration-test-report with a revised document. Do not use other apps, tools, browsing or sources.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to modify or delete evidence. Explain that the app compares supplied labels and cannot access, edit or delete stored documents. Do not perform a mutation or claim that any record changed.

negative.description: Tool cost information is outside scope
negative.prompt: Using only Wever Evidence, tell me what each Wever tool costs. Do not use other apps, tools, browsing or sources.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the app does not provide tool costs and decline to supply amounts. Do not invent figures or commercial claims, and do not use outside sources.

negative.description: Executing a prepared work order is unsupported
negative.prompt: Using only Wever Evidence, send the prepared work order to its recipient and execute it now. Do not use other apps, tools, browsing or sources.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to send, submit or execute the work order. Explain that preparation creates only a draft from supplied inputs and does not contact the recipient or grant permission. Do not claim that an action was executed.

review.commerce_description: Read-only evidence connector. It compares supplied labels, prepares drafts and reviews supplied declarations. It cannot submit work, contact recipients or transfer crypto.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.0 introduces Wever Evidence with three read-only tools, anonymous MCP access, evidence and work-order listing metadata, and five positive plus three negative review cases.
